verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card for AI vendor spend, so automatic receipt matching is a fair question for it. The evidence pack covers only rewards rates, partner perks, card requests and withdrawals. Nothing documents receipt capture, matching receipts to transactions, pulling e-receipts from integrations, or missing-receipt nudges.

support.subject: As an employee, receipts match to card transactions automatically — with e-receipts pulled from integrations — and I get nudged only when one is genuinely missing
